<!-- agent-note:v1 agent=repo-worker-code lane=item-work-114 state=done task=23304 -->
**#7983 item 2 record (queue task 23304, via #14010): pkgs/id/web response-cast inventory complete — the last unguarded cast now lands a boundary check.**

Inventory method: every `response.json()`, `JSON.parse`, and WebSocket-frame site in `pkgs/id/web/src/main.ts`, `src/world.ts`, `src/home.ts`, re-derived from source on the fix branch.

**Guarded by a parse/is boundary check (surface error vocabulary, fail-closed):**
- main.ts: `/api/identity/me` → `parseIdentityMeResponse`; identity register → `parseIdentityRegisterResponse`; identity name → `parseIdentityNameResponse`; `/api/tags` → `parseTagsResponse`; `/api/files/send` → `isSendFileResponse`; `/api/save` → `isSaveFileResponse`; `/api/new` → `isNewFileResponse`; `/api/rename` → `isRenameFileResponse`; `/api/copy` → `isCopyFileResponse`.
- world.ts: host view → `parseWorldHostViewPage`; invite → `parseWorldInviteResponse`. The three `JSON.parse(...) as unknown` frame sites check `isRecord` + string `type` before the `as WorldFrame` narrowing, with per-type deep guards (`isWorldSnapshot`, `isWorldEvent`, `hasNonStringField`) before any field is relied on — the cast is a narrowing behind a runtime check, not a boundary bypass.
- home.ts: feed → `parseHomeFeed`.

**Was unguarded — fixed by this item:** main.ts `/ws/tags` broadcast frames were `JSON.parse(event.data as string)` with fields read directly. Now validated by `parseTagWsEvent` in `tags-response.ts`; wrong-shape frames are ignored, never refreshed against. Landed in the PR linked from #14010 (28/28 tags-response tests pass, including 14 new fail-closed cases).

**Dispositions:** none needed — no response cast in the three files turned out to be a non-boundary cast. The remaining `as` casts in these files are DOM element typing (`as HTMLElement`, `as HTMLInputElement`, …), which are not response casts and are out of this item's scope.

**Pattern for items 3–10 (per #14010):** (1) inventory every `response.json()` / `JSON.parse` / WS-frame site in the surface; (2) each body passes a `parse*`/`is*Response` guard in the surface's error vocabulary before any field is read, failing closed on wrong shape; (3) an `as` cast is acceptable only as a narrowing behind such a runtime check; (4) anything genuinely not a trust boundary gets a one-line disposition here instead of a check.
